source_caption_text:
Yeah, yeah, you came back and you failed, uh

Playboi Carti’s “2024” came out in December 2023 and quickly became one of the most talked-about songs from the rollout for *Music*. The production from Ojivolta, Earl on the Beat and Kanye West gives the track a huge, hypnotic feel without overcrowding Carti’s vocals.

One of the standout parts is the way the production builds around the pitched-up vocal sample, with the drums and 808s keeping things simple underneath it. Kanye’s touch is especially noticeable in how the sample becomes the main part of the track rather than just sitting in the background.

Carti also switches things up vocally, starting with his higher-pitched delivery before bringing in the deeper voice that became a major part of his *Music* era. That switch, combined with the production, is what makes “2024” such a memorable moment from the rollout.
